    The ideal generated by a representative #

    For split basic data of a distributive algebra and a morphism t of the projective category, every nonzero morphism whose value lies in the two-sided ideal generated by t has a ray that is a two-sided multiple of the ray of t (SplitBasicData.ray_factorsThrough_of_mem_span).
